rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 and single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996 are fully covered by rent control, allowing rent increase limits.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a unit in a multifamily building built before 1980 or a single-family home with tenancy started before 1996, your rent is controlled and can only be increased within limits.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquila una unidad en un edificio multifamiliar construido antes de 1980 o una casa unifamiliar con un contrato de arrendamiento iniciado antes de 1996, su renta está controlada y solo puede aumentarse dentro de los límites.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980; single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996; rooming houses with five or more rooms rented individually; partially covered for new construction after June 1980 and single-family homes with tenancy started on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; units with certain government subsidies.
rules.exemptions_text: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied duplex on Dec 31, 1979 with owner living in one unit); units where owner shares kitchen or bath with tenant and owner lived on property at tenancy start; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties with ADU and owner-occupied unit; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.quoted_span:

Single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Just cause eviction protections apply to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 and single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, among others.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a covered unit in Berkeley, your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you under the just cause eviction rules.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquila una unidad cubierta en Berkeley, su arrendador debe tener una razón válida para desalojarlo bajo las reglas de desalojo por causa justificada.

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance
rules.requirement: Security deposit rules including interest apply to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980 and single family homes with current tenancies that began before 1996, among others.
rules.summary_plain: If you rent a covered unit in Berkeley, your security deposit is subject to rules including payment of interest.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si alquila una unidad cubierta en Berkeley, su depósito de seguridad está sujeto a reglas que incluyen el pago de intereses.
